finding.evidence: request with Cookie: session=admin-7c9e returns the admin dashboard
finding.description: The session value is static and guessable.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: broken-access-control (The session value is static and guessable. Evidence: request with Cookie: session=admin-7c9e returns the admin dashboard). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Recommended fix for Cookie: session=admin-7c9e returning the admin dashboard: enforce Broken Access Control remediation server-side — deny by default and check authorization on every request. Do not trust the client-supplied session value for privilege; require a server-managed authenticated session and explicitly deny access to the admin dashboard unless the session is authorized for admin, per OWASP A01 Broken Access Control.

verification.detail: Maintaining its position at #1 in the Top Ten, 100% of the applications tested were found to have some form of broken access control.

fix.summary: Replace static admin cookie with random server-managed session checked by equality, denying by default.
fix.risk: In-memory session resets on restart requiring re-login; naive cookie parsing could mismatch exotic cookie formats.

applied.find: if (p.user === 'admin' && p.password === 'maisonverde2019') return [302, { location: '/admin', 'set-cookie': 'session=admin-7c9e; Path=/' }, '']; // FLAW 8 (cookie): no HttpOnly, Secure or SameSite
applied.replace: if (p.user === 'admin' && p.password === 'maisonverde2019') { adminSession = 'admin-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); return [302, { location: '/admin', 'set-cookie': `session=${adminSession}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict` }, '']; }
